129.description: This vector activates on Thai script characters and diacritics.

12.description: These tokens represent common prefixes and combining forms used in scientific and technical terminology.

10.description: This feature vector detects multilingual text fragments and sub-word tokens containing the sequence "wh" or its phonetic equivalents.

180.description: These tokens represent the concept of categories, types, styles, or systems across different languages (predominantly Thai and some fragments).

157.description: This vector represents characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens of the Thai writing system.

161.description: This vector activates on common medical and scientific suffixes, word roots, and mixed-script morphological fragments.

151.description: This feature represents a mix of multilingual text fragments, technical abbreviations, and common subword tokens without a unified semantic theme.

196.description: This vector activates strongly on mixed-script proper nouns, names, and loanwords, particularly in French and Thai.

77.description: This feature vector represents terms associated with the prefix, abbreviation, or concept related to "Gram" (such as Gram stain, tuberculosis/TB, and related linguistic or scientific tokens).

13.description: This feature vector activates strongly on biological and genetic terminology, particularly terms related to nucleic acids and lipids.
